snippet.title: My Putrid Ponies - Trailer
snippet.description:
"My Putrid Ponies" is a horror adventure set in a once-idyllic pony ranch now overrun by undead equines. As the last surviving, your mission is to uncover the mystery behind the ponies zombies outbreak while navigating through haunting landscapes filled with danger and despair.

Add it to Steam wishlist.

I want to clarify that the game I am developing is entirely original and has no connection to other works. It features its own unique storyline and characters. While I may have drawn inspiration from various sources, including certain themes or aesthetics, the intention is not to replicate or borrow ideas from any existing works. My goal is to create a distinct experience that stands on its own, showcasing originality and creativity.
